exposure.needed: which dashboards, alerting/recording rules, or other metric consumers query the metric name lbipam_ips_available_total

consequence.statement: The metric is exposed under the new name lbipam_ips_available; monitoring that still queries lbipam_ips_available_total no longer receives that metric series.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerting and recording rules, and any other metric consumers to query lbipam_ips_available instead of lbipam_ips_available_total.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 renames the LB-IPAM metric lbipam_ips_available_total to lbipam_ips_available, so anything querying the old metric name must be updated to the new name.
